methods.name: create
methods.summary: Create a new OAuth client for an account.
methods.description: Create a new OAuth client for an account.

props.name: account_id
props.description: Account identifier tag.

props.name: client_name
props.description: Human-readable name of the OAuth client.

props.name: grant_types
props.description:
Array of OAuth grant types the client is allowed to use.
`authorization_code` is required; `refresh_token` may be included optionally.

props.name: redirect_uris
props.description: Array of allowed redirect URIs for the client.

props.name: response_types
props.description: Array of OAuth response types the client is allowed to use.

props.name: scopes
props.description:
Array of OAuth scopes the client is allowed to request.
Colon-delimited scopes are not accepted. Dot-delimited scopes are validated
against available OAuth API scopes; simple identity scopes are allowed. Protocol
scopes `offline_access` and `openid` are added or removed automatically based on
`grant_types` and `response_types`.

props.name: token_endpoint_auth_method
props.description: The authentication method the client uses at the token endpoint.

props.name: allowed_cors_origins
props.description: Array of allowed CORS origins.

props.name: client_uri
props.description: URL of the home page of the client.

props.name: logo_uri
props.description: URL of the client's logo.

props.name: policy_uri
props.description: URL that points to a privacy policy document.

props.name: post_logout_redirect_uris
props.description: Array of allowed post-logout redirect URIs.

props.name: tos_uri
props.description: URL that points to a terms of service document.

non-identity scope.
